newsitem.title: USA: IMF's Fischer lauds Mexico's economic policies.
newsitem.headline: IMF's Fischer lauds Mexico's economic policies.

text.p: International Monetary Fund First Deputy Managing Director Stanley Fischer praised Mexico's economic program on Tuesday and said he expects little policy change in the near future.

"The Mexicans, since the beginning of 1995, have run superb policies and the evidence is in what's happened to the economy," Fischer said, answering reporters' questions after giving an address to the National Economics Club here.
"I don't expect any changes," he added.
Fischer said that Mexico's economic recovery over the past seven years has surprised economists.
"It is a very impressive performance since 1990. A far more evident recovery than anyone expected; a more evident return to stability," he said.
